scripts.speaker: Stalker
scripts.text:
Heh...
It's tough
being a hero
and being shady,
untrustworthy,
sneaky...

scripts.speaker: Stalker
scripts.text:
But when the
going gets rough
my pals know they
can count on me.
I need them and
they need me.

scripts.speaker: Stalker
scripts.text:
This world needs
more heroes who are
willing to walk the line
between order and lawlessness.

scripts.speaker: Stalker
scripts.text:
Are you ready
to join the ranks
of the sneakiest of
warriors? Are you ready
to become a Stalker?

scripts.speaker: Stalker
scripts.text:
When you're ready,
feel free to come back.
Honor to the warriors!

scripts.speaker: Stalker
scripts.text:
It is still possible for you to learn more skills. Please use
all of your remaining Skill Points before returning to me.

scripts.speaker: Stalker
scripts.text:
Congratulations!
As a Stalker, I hope
you stab the right people
in the back. Banish the
wicked using their own
dastardly methods!

scripts.speaker: Stalker
scripts.text:
Welcome
to Valhalla,
the Hall of Honor.

scripts.speaker: Stalker
scripts.text:
Please make
yourself comfortable
while you are here.
Honor to the warriors!
